idea-plugin.name: Pytest Run Params
idea-plugin.description:
Pytest Params panel: pytest run options as checkboxes. Standard pytest options are added with «+», custom ones (e.g. conftest options) are typed in; every row has a checkbox, a value and a remove button.
Enabled options become the Additional Arguments of the pytest template and of temporary (▶) configurations; saved configurations are left untouched. The same checkboxes are available on the Run tab toolbar of pytest runs and in the status bar.
Run with Pytest Params (Project view) runs a folder or test file as a temporary configuration with these options, even when a saved configuration has the same target (the standard Run reuses it). On the Run tab of a saved configuration the checkboxes edit that configuration's own arguments. pytest and Autodetect configurations are supported.

action.description: Run as a temporary pytest configuration with the Pytest Params options
Run only failed and not run tests of the counted module (passed tests are skipped)
